It was written and produced by Keys and [[Kerry Brothers Jr.]], with additional writing by [[DJ Dirty Harry]]. "No One" is a song recorded by American singer-songwriter Alicia Keys for her third studio album As I Am (2007). It was written and produced by Keys and Kerry Brothers Jr., with additional writing by DJ Dirty Harry. The song was released as the lead single from As I Am on September 10, 2007, by J Records.

A commercial success, "No One" topped the US Billboard Hot 100 for five consecutive weeks and also reached number one in Croatia, Hungary and Switzerland, while charting within the top ten in 18 additional countries. It was the third most successful song of 2008 in Brazil and the United States, and was the most listened song on US radio, with 3.08 billion listeners. It was also the sixth most successful song of the 2000s decade in the US.

"No One" is certified diamond by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA), and has sold 5.6 million copies worldwide. Critically acclaimed, it won Best Female R&B Vocal Performance and Best R&B Song at the 50th Annual Grammy Awards (2008).

sections.heading: Background and release
Critical reception
sections.wikitext:
"No One" received critical acclaim upon release. [[Popjustice]] viewed the song as "one of [Keys'] best singles to date and possibly one of the eight best ballads of 2007".<ref name="popjustice">{{cite web |url=https://www.popjustice.com/songs/alicia-keys-no-one/ |title=Alicia Keys – 'No One' |publisher=[[Popjustice]] |date=September 18, 2007 |access-date=August 25, 2015}}</ref> Chuck Taylor of ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' wrote that the song "shows the soulful chanteuse acting her age, in the best possible way" and that Keys "hold[s] back on the mastery of vocal craft to let cool, crisp production lead", adding that it "heralds her youth, while maintaining Keys' lockdown on penetrating hooks and soul-sopped production with a buoyancy that makes it a blast to sing along with."<ref>{{cite magazine |last=Taylor |first=Chuck |url=https://worldradiohistory.com/Archive-All-Music/Billboard/00s/2007/BB-2007-09-29.pdf |title=The Billboard Reviews: Singles |magazine=Billboard |volume=119 |issue=39 |date=September 29, 2007 |page=54 |issn=0006-2510 |via=World Radio History}}</ref> Anthony Venutolo of ''[[The Star-Ledger]]'' felt that on "No One", Keys "attempts to offer uplift through cliches".<ref>{{cite web |last=Venutolo |first=Anthony |url=http://www.nj.com/entertainment/music/index.ssf/2007/11/as_she_is_isnt_the_best_she_ca.html |title=As she is isn't the best she can be |work=[[The Star-Ledger]] |date=November 9, 2007 |access-date=August 25, 2015}}</ref>

Alex Fletcher of [[Digital Spy]] gave the song four stars out of five and called it "simplistic yet beautiful, fluttering, piano-tinkling ballad", the lyrics of which "expose Keys' vulnerability and current loved-up status".<ref name="digitalspy">{{cite web |last=Fletcher |first=Alex |url=http://www.digitalspy.com/music/single-reviews/review/a79390/alicia-keys-no-one/ |title=Alicia Keys: 'No-One' |work=[[Digital Spy]] |date=November 7, 2007 |access-date=December 30, 2017}}</ref> David Mead of ''[[Paste (magazine)|Paste]]'' commented that the song "showcases a new depth and width to the tone of her voice, which seems to get closer to that of [[Aretha Franklin]] with each album."<ref>{{cite web |last=Mead |first=David |url=https://www.pastemagazine.com/articles/2007/11/as-i-am.html |title=Alicia Keys: As I Am |work=[[Paste (magazine)|Paste]] |date=November 12, 2007 |access-date=August 25, 2015 |archive-date=April 18, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230418180748/https://www.pastemagazine.com/articles/2007/11/as-i-am.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> [[Nekesa Mumbi Moody]] of ''[[The Washington Post]]'' cited "No One" as one of the "gems" of the album and stated it "recalls a [[Bob Marley]] groove".<ref>{{cite news |last=Moody |first=Nekesa Mumbi |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2007/11/09/AR2007110901680.html |title=Music Review: Alicia Keys CD 'As I Am' |newspaper=[[The Washington Post]] |date=November 9, 2007 |access-date=August 25, 2015}}</ref>

sections.heading: Commercial performance
sections.wikitext:
[[File:Alicia Keys Sing.jpg|thumb|150px|Keys during a concert in Portugal, where "No One" reached number two]]
With only one full day of [[airplay]], "No One" debuted at number 65 on the US ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' [[Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs]] chart on the issue dated September 8, 2007. Seven weeks later, it reached the top position for 10 weeks—becoming Keys' fifth number-one single on the chart—before being knocked out by her own song "[[Like You'll Never See Me Again]]" during the first charting week of 2008. The song initially debuted at number 15 on the [[Bubbling Under Hot 100 Singles]] for the week of September 15, 2007, and managed to jump to the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] at number 71 the following week without the benefit of [[music download|download]] sales.<ref>{{cite magazine |last=Hasty |first=Katie |url=https://www.billboard.com/articles/news/1049338/soulja-boy-remains-no-1-amid-static-top-four |title=Soulja Boy Remains No. 1 Amid Static Top Four |magazine=Billboard |date=September 13, 2007 |access-date=March 24, 2013}}</ref> The following week, it rose to number 15 because of digital downloads, and reached the top spot the charting week of December 1, 2007, staying atop for five weeks. In the week between October 22–25, 2007, "No One" gained 14.3% in radio airplay and audience impressions which marks the single at number one.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://blogs.usatoday.com/listenup/2007/10/alicia-extends-.html |title=Alicia extends airplay lead; Kanye streaks to second |work=[[USA Today]] |date=October 30, 2007 |access-date=November 1, 2007 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080508040103/http://blogs.usatoday.com/listenup/2007/10/alicia-extends-.html |archive-date=May 8, 2008}}</ref> It is Keys' first solo single to reach number one on the Hot 100 since her debut single "[[Fallin' (Alicia Keys song)|Fallin']]" (2001) and her third single to top the chart. It is also the overall biggest hit that peaked in 2007.<ref>{{cite magazine | url=https://www.billboard.com/charts/hot-100-60th-anniversary | title=Hot 100 60th Anniversary | magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]] }}</ref>

Additionally, "No One" went on to top several other [[Billboard charts|''Billboard'' charts]], including the [[Pop 100]] chart, the [[Pop 100 Airplay]] chart, the [[Mainstream Top 40 (Pop Songs)|Mainstream Top 40]], and the [[Rhythmic Airplay Chart|Rhythmic Airplay]] chart.<ref name="allmusic"/> By June 2014, the song had sold four million copies in the United States.<ref name="yahooJun2014">{{cite web |last=Grein |first=Paul |url=https://www.yahoo.com/music/blogs/chart-watch/chart-watch-rude-summer-hit-top-10-214615906.html |title=Chart Watch: 'Rude,' 'Summer' Hit Top 10 |publisher=[[Yahoo! Music]] |date=June 5, 2014 |access-date=August 28, 2017}}</ref> "No One" was the most listened-to song on US radio of 2008, with 3.08 billion listeners.<ref>{{cite magazine |url=https://www.rollingstone.com/music/news/alicia-keys-flo-rida-top-nielsen-year-end-charts-20081216 |title=Alicia Keys, Flo Rida Top Nielsen Year-End Charts |magazine=[[Rolling Stone]] |date=December 16, 2008 |access-date=December 30, 2017}}</ref> ''Billboard'' ranked it at number 48 on the list of "The All-Time Top 100 Songs" in 2013 and at number 14 on the list of the "Top Billboard Hot 100 R&B/Hip-Hop Songs" in 2008.<ref name="Hot 100 All-Time">{{cite magazine |last=Bronson |first=Fred |title=Hot 100 60th Anniversary |magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]] |url=https://www.billboard.com/charts/hot-100-60th-anniversary}}</ref><ref name="Hot R&B All-Time"/> In 2009, the song was placed at number six on the ''Billboard'' Hot 100 decade-end chart.<ref name="decade-end"/>

The single was commercially successful in Europe as well, peaking at number two on the [[European Hot 100 Singles]] as well as reaching the top position in Hungary and Switzerland, and peaked within the top ten of the charts in Austria, Belgium, Denmark, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, the Republic of Ireland, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, and the United Kingdom. In the latter country, "No One" has re-entered the [[UK Singles Chart]] twice since its official release, both times due to exposure on British television (firstly after being performed by an auditionee on ''[[Britain's Got Talent]]'' and secondly after Keys herself performed it within a medley on ''[[The X Factor (UK TV series)|The X Factor]]''). In May 2009, it re-entered at number 54 on the UK Singles Chart, and in December 2009 it re-entered at number 51 on the chart.

It also charted highly in Oceania, peaking within the top ten of the charts in Australia and New Zealand. According to the [[International Federation of the Phonographic Industry]] (IFPI), "No One" has sold 5.6 million copies.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ifpi.org/content/library/DMR2009.pdf |title=Top 10 Digital Single Tracks 2008 |page=7 |publisher=[[International Federation of the Phonographic Industry]] |year=2009 |access-date=October 4, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924033145/http://www.ifpi.org/content/library/DMR2009.pdf |archive-date=September 24, 2015 |url-status=live}}</ref>
